product_mix.note: Ten of 30 ads sell the Intellon water purifier, ten sell fans (six ceiling, three pedestal, one exhaust), eight sell the Zenova mixer grinder and two sell a smart lock; none shows a price.

series.name: Zenova regional demo set
series.note: Five ads share one headline and one long ad text, started between 2026-08-02 and 2026-08-10 and have run 102 to 110 days, in Tamil, Telugu or unreadable speech.

series.name: Gag box, then the real product
series.note: A fake AutoMatka box (water purifier) and a fake AutoSilbatta box (mixer) are pitched as jokes before the real Atomberg product appears.

series.name: Technician and AMC trust
series.note: Four Intellon ads, from 14 to 242 days live, are built on distrust of RO service bills and the filter-health app.

series.name: Rupee saving line on fans
series.note: Six of ten fan ads carry a ₹1,500 a year or ₹400 a summer saving, each worded differently between speech, card and ad text.

contradictions.text: The ₹1,500 fan saving is 'every season' in one caption, 'per year' on the box and in the ad text, 'every year' in a headline over a video that never says it, and no period in the speech.
The pedestal saving is 'every season' in the ad text and 'every summer' on the card, and the voice drops 'up to' and says a flat ₹400.
The Intellon promises a 2-year unconditional warranty, 2 years with no service cost, no AMC, zero maintenance and the lowest maintenance costs, in different ads and with no terms shown.
The Intellon's saving is 2X more water saving in one ad, about 25,000 rupees over 8 years in another, a litres-a-day usage chart in a third and up to ₹13,000 on the static.
The smart lock ad text says 6 ways of unlocking; the box shows five icons and the voice names four.
